content: Tana Isak isu, mi iboobo Yakop ma imar. To ipomboli mi iur sua mbolŋana pini ta kembei. Iso: “Woolo moori tasa ki Kanaan pepe.
Maŋga ma la pa lele Mesopotamia ta buri. Mi la ta ruumu ki tumbum Betuel, to woolo wom Laban lutuunu moori sa.
Anutu mbura keskeezeŋana ko ipombolu mi ikam lem pikin boozomen ma kamasak bekena we tomtom boozomen un.
Mi ni ko ipombolu mi zin popoŋana ku, kembei ta ipombol tumbum Abaraam. Naso nu irao kam lem toono biibi tiŋgi, ta we leembe pa i. Pa toono tiŋgi, Anutu imbuk ka sua pa tumbum Abaraam ta muŋgu kek.”
Isak iso sua tana pa Yakop makiŋ, to iuri ma ila pa Mesopotamia, be ila ki woono Laban, ta Betuel lutuunu na.
Indeeŋe ta Isak ipombol Yakop mi iuri ma ila pa Mesopotamia na, iur sua mbolŋana pini be irao iwoolo moori ki lele tana men. Mi iŋgalsek pini be iwoolo Kanaan nan sa pepe.
Tabe Isau ileŋ sua tina, mi ire kembei Yakop isombe ito tamaana ziru naana kalŋan mi ila pa Mesopotamia,
tona ikilaala ta kembei: Kanaan nan ru ta ni iwoolo zin na, tamaana leleene pizin risa som.
Tana ni izem tamaana ma naana, mi ila ki tamaana kolmanŋana Ismael, mi iwoolo moori toro, zaana Maalat. Maalat toono zaana Nebaiot. Ziru Ismael lutuunu bizin.
Yakop ire miuŋana isu kar Betel
Tana Yakop imaŋga, mi izem kar Ber-Seba, mi isombe ila pa kar Aran.
Ni iwwa ma ila ipet lele ta, mi mbeŋkaali. Tana isu to iŋgas pat pakan ma iliu i, mi ikam pat ta ma ikiliigi, mi ikeene.
To imiu mi ire koroŋ kembei ndeete ta imbot saamba mi isu toono. Mi zin aŋela ki Anutu tizzu mi tizalla pa.
To Merere itunu tau imender sala ndeete uteene, mi iso pini ma iso: “Nio Merere, Anutu ki tumbum Abaraam mi tomom Isak. Toono ta kenne pa i, ina nio ko aŋkam pu mi popoŋana ku ma iwe leyom.

Mi popoŋana ku kola tipet ma timasak ma tiwe boozomen, kembei ta ululu ki toono. Mi zin ko tipera mi tilela, mi tila pa zilŋaana zilŋaana bekena tirao pa toono ta boozomen. Mi nu niomŋan popoŋana ku ko kewe zaala be kampeŋana biibi ise kizin wal boozomen ta timbotmbot toono na.

Nio ko aŋbotmbot raamu mi motoŋ pu pa lele boozomen tabe la pa i. Mi ko aŋkamu ma miili ma mar mini pa lele tiŋgi. Tana nio ko irao aŋzemu na som. Ko aŋbotmbot raamu, mi aŋkam ma sua tio mbukŋana ti iur ŋonoono.”
Tona Yakop ipol ma imaŋga mi iso: “Ŋonoono kat! Merere imbotmbot lele ti. Mi muŋgu nio aŋute som.”
To motoŋana ikami. Tabe iso: “Lele tiŋgi potomŋana kat! Ikam yo ma aŋmoto koŋ. Pa iŋgi sa Anutu muriini na! Mi zaala saamba kana kwoono ta ti.”
Mankwoono, mbeŋbeŋŋana na, Yakop ikam pat ta ikiliigi na, ma isuŋgun su toono be iwe kilalan pa lele tana. To iliŋ ŋgere isalakaala pat tina.
Mi ipaata lele tana zaana be Betel. Muŋgu na, kar tana zaana Lus.

To Yakop imbuk sua pa Anutu ta kembei: “Merere, sombe nu lae tio mi mboro yo pa pai tio ti, mi kam koŋ kini mi leŋ mburu be aŋzeebe yo pa i, mi sombe aŋbot ambai men ma irao aŋmiili ma aŋmar mini pa ruumu ki tamaŋ, inako nu we Anutu tio, mi nio ko aŋbeeze pa nu itum tamen.
Mi koroŋ boozomen ta so nu kam pio na, nio ko aŋpeete ma iwe pakaana laamuru, mi pakaana ta ko aŋpas ma ima pu. Mi pat ta aŋsuŋgun su ti, iŋgi iwe kilalan kembei lele tiŋgi na Anutu muriini.”
